release.changelog: - ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 support: 800x480 RGB panel and GT1151 touch, built and flashed with PlatformIO.

esp32s31-korvo1.guide: The ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 publishes no firmware yet. Build it with pio run -e esp32s31-korvo1 and flash it over USB.
esp32s31-korvo1.changelog: - ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 support: 800x480 RGB panel and GT1151 touch, built and flashed with PlatformIO.

esp32s31-default.guide: The ESP32-S31 placeholder environment publishes no firmware. Use the ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 board instead: pio run -e esp32s31-korvo1.
esp32s31-default.changelog: - ESP32-S31-Korvo-1 support: 800x480 RGB panel and GT1151 touch, built and flashed with PlatformIO.
